## Current suite

Playwright 1.64.1, 2, 4 workers per shard as the Workers column shows, retries 0, suite `tests@20dd436537e6 playwright.config.ts@e49fa62d3d2b package-lock.json@402b909d1dbd`. `fullyParallel` as the Fully parallel column shows, read from the config metadata in each shard’s blob report. 104 runs. Times are seconds. Job times come from the GitHub Actions API, Playwright times from each shard’s blob report.

### Summary

Medians over the runs of each arm. The ideal bound is the balanced lower bound for the slowest shard’s Playwright time. "vs native" compares a median with the native median at the same shard count, workers and fullyParallel. `smart` runs are the ones the Action balanced from its history; the cold start is the first smart run, which had no history and ran native sharding; `rollback` ran the smart workflow with `enabled: false`. `@sha` is the Action commit. Completion and "without finish" are defined under Runs; native has no finish step, so its two completions match.

### Ideal bound

From the median duration of each test over the native runs: 531.7 s of test time outside the setup project and 3.0 s of setup that every shard runs. With fullyParallel on, a test or a serial describe is indivisible, and the longest is 9.7 s (`chromium › e2e/serial-ledger.spec.ts › serial ledger`). With fullyParallel off, a spec file is indivisible, and the longest is 11.7 s (`chromium › e2e/reports-sharing.spec.ts`). The bound is setup + max(total / (shards × workers), longest unit).

| Shards | Workers | Fully parallel | Total / (shards × workers) | Longest unit | Ideal bound |

| 4 | 2 | yes | 66.5 s | 9.7 s | 69.5 s |
| 4 | 4 | yes | 33.2 s | 9.7 s | 36.2 s |
| 8 | 2 | yes | 33.2 s | 9.7 s | 36.2 s |
| 8 | 4 | yes | 16.6 s | 9.7 s | 19.6 s |
| 4 | 2 | no | 66.5 s | 11.7 s | 69.5 s |
| 4 | 4 | no | 33.2 s | 11.7 s | 36.2 s |
| 8 | 2 | no | 33.2 s | 11.7 s | 36.2 s |
| 8 | 4 | no | 16.6 s | 11.7 s | 19.6 s |

### Runs

Completion runs from the first job start to the last job end. From schema 3 it leaves out the two steps of smart.yml that keep the Action’s outputs for this benchmark, and "without finish" also leaves out the Action’s optional finish step. Queue is the longest wait of a shard job between creation and start. Machine time is the sum of the shard job durations. Notes name other runs of the repository whose jobs ran during this run and shared the runner pool, a shard job that waited more than 30 s to start, and a run dispatched from a branch other than main.

Playwright 1.64.1, 1, 2, 4 workers per shard as the Workers column shows, retries 0, suite `tests@3259c416b64e playwright.config.ts@372695034943 package-lock.json@402b909d1dbd`. `fullyParallel` is off in that `playwright.config.ts`. 38 runs. Times are seconds. Job times come from the GitHub Actions API, Playwright times from each shard’s blob report.

Medians over the runs of each arm. The ideal bound is the balanced lower bound for the slowest shard’s Playwright time. ### Ideal bound

From the median duration of each test over the native runs: 420.9 s of test time outside the setup project and 3.0 s of setup that every shard runs. With fullyParallel off, a spec file is indivisible, and the longest is 55.0 s (`chromium › e2e/checkout-payments.spec.ts`). The bound is setup + max(total / (shards × workers), longest unit).

| Shards | Workers | Fully parallel | Total / (shards × workers) | Longest unit | Ideal bound |
| ---: | ---: | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 4 | 1 | no | 105.2 s | 55.0 s | 108.2 s |
| 4 | 2 | no | 52.6 s | 55.0 s | 58.0 s |
| 4 | 4 | no | 26.3 s | 55.0 s | 58.0 s |
| 8 | 1 | no | 52.6 s | 55.0 s | 58.0 s |

### Runs

Completion runs from the first job start to the last job end. From schema 3 it leaves out the two steps of smart.yml that keep the Action’s outputs for this benchmark, and "without finish" also leaves out the Action’s optional finish step. Queue is the longest wait of a shard job between creation and start. Machine time is the sum of the shard job durations. Notes name other runs of the repository whose jobs ran during this run and shared the runner pool, a shard job that waited more than 30 s to start, and a run dispatched from a branch other than main.
